notes: nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b for LiteRT (litert-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b): nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (revision ea30d66d, openmdw-1.1), a cache-aware streaming FastConformer encoder with an RNN-T decoder and a language prompt, rewritten as plain PyTorch graphs (no NeMo) and exported with litert-torch 0.10.0 for LiteRT 2.3.0 at lookahead 3 (320 ms chunks): mel, pre (the subsampling with its convolution caches), the 24-layer conformer with its attention and convolution caches as graph inputs and outputs, and the RNN-T decoder (predict, joint); the host carries the caches from chunk to chunk and runs the greedy RNN-T loop (at most 10 tokens per encoder frame). The float16 conformers scale each of their 144 LayerNorm inputs by 2^-k (k 2-9) so float16 arithmetic stays finite. Accuracy = WER (CER for FLEURS Japanese) against the reference: transformers 5.22.1 Nemotron3_5AsrForRNNT in float32 on the same chunks with the same 5,520 zeros appended, greedy decoding, each set's language-locale as the prompt; L = the Open ASR Leaderboard's scoring, J = jiwer on the same normalized text. This file: nemotron_asr_pre.tflite (18,402,700 B; the card's Files table: the 8× subsampling with its three convolution caches: `pre_first` and `pre` (25 or 32 mel frames → 4 frames of 1,024); backend CPU). artifact_sha256 = = the work graph pre.tflite that the phones were sent (the phone's sha256 read-back MATCH in each frame). LANDED: nemotron_asr_pre.tflite (sha256 0334afcbdd9686745683f9354ed7833be3c70fead76da727342a8c9054a4dac1, 18,402,700 B) is in litert-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b from commit b2a2190cd36b4ca2e43a4f77b5af4c0165db559f (uploaded 2026-11-03 14:02 JST); the Hub tree read at 2026-11-03T14:15:43+09:00 (main b2a2190c) gives this LFS oid and size. Pixel 11 Pro, 2026-11-03: for each form that loads this file, the runs behind the card's Performance row (two runs, A B B A), its Sustained bullet and S4 / J200 columns, and the GPU bullet's runs — CPU: J200 r6p1d_cpu_j200, S4 rp11d_cpu_s4b, T rp13c7_fp16ws_fc_t4swap_b1, T rp13c7_fp16ws_fc_t4swap_b2. Runners: nemotron-runner; nemotron-runner-r3. Not records: the other setting of each A B B A pair, whose median the card prints at most as the comparison (g32 188.835 ms; swap 142.610 ms; t5copy 74.087 ms); the cold JIT compile runs (their partition line is cited); the runs the card's Notes or usage text cite for one fact each (rp12d_cpu_j200, rp13c7_fp16ws_fc_t5copy_a1, rp13c7_fp16ws_fc_t5copy_a2, rp14d_s32_fp16ws_fc_t4swap, the A B B A arms and cold runs among them); the card's usage-block runs; and every run of a form that is not Records written.
